notes: Scan = 4 variants of Carry (pass shot 2: S1 0.35, S2a 0.50, S2b 0.75, S2a 1.00, S3 1.25-1.55). Back view (from behind; the goal far up-screen), not mirrored. Registration = Idle Back: body centre x 64, soles on row 102; the camera rides with him, so the sprite does not travel (the stride bob is drawn: pelvis y 65 on the down frames, 63 on the passing frames; head 19 -> 17). contact = the centre of the planted sole on row 102: right (72,102) on B1 B2 S1 S2a S2b, left (55,102) on B3 B4 S3. head = the skull (sightline origin). ball = the ball guide centre (B1/S1 touched at the right toe, then rolling ahead up-screen); the ball sits up-screen of the boot, so draw it before (behind) the sprite where they overlap. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1] measured on the art. Studio layer: Art only (numbers in Art; no Num/Ball layer, MERIDIAN plan §7.7). The ball is never drawn in a frame: the game draws it at ball/boot.
